puzzle.hint: A beautiful supplication taught in the Quran, asking Allah for forgiveness and mercy - one of the most moving du'as in the Muslim scripture.
puzzle.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
